PB.role2: older draft of this hand: keep only its idea of a broad gauntlet with coffin nails on the knuckles; materials and colours follow image 3
PB.text:
THE HAND: the Pallbearer's left hand, a broad gauntlet of polished silver plate exactly like the Pallbearer in image 3 (bright steel plates, brass rivets and trims), with a row of FOUR big round silver coffin-nail heads on the knuckle plate; at the wrist a short purple pall-cloth cuff with a white border (the purple and white of his tabard in image 3). Line: "Lift with the legs. And with the heart."
SHOWCASE MOMENT: the heavy gauntlet has just turned from back to palm: a crisp candlelit highlight runs along the row of coffin nails; a little pale stone grit and grey mortar dust falls from the knuckle plates in a few chunky flakes, as if the hand has just pulled free of the Wall; the open palm shows a broad worn leather palm patch with ONE dark rope groove across it from carrying coffins. The metal never glows: only reflected warm candlelight and a soft cool rim on the plates. Strong, protective, steady.
COLOURS: steel #C8CBCB and #6E7276, purple #5B2A86 with a white border, brass #B08A3E; warm candle #E0A050.

FL.role2: approved design of this exact hand: keep its sleeve, cords, chain cuff, wraps and colours
FL.text:
THE HAND: the Flagellant's slender left hand exactly as in image 2: a deep red laced leather sleeve cuff, a thick knotted red cord wound TWICE around the wrist, a black leather band with a short iron chain, cream linen wraps over the palm and the base of the thumb. Line: "Pain is the only prayer that never lies."
SHOWCASE MOMENT: the knotted cord has just pulled tight around the wrist; the hand trembles once and opens palm-up; two or three cold dark chain links swing from the cuff; the candle flame leans hard toward her hand and flickers, throwing a warm light across the open linen-wrapped palm. The hand itself has NO glow and no light of its own. Fierce devotion, restraint, quiet pain without any wound or blood.
COLOURS: deep red #8E1F24, black leather #1E1B1C, iron #45464A, linen #CBBFA6; warm candle #E0A050.

OS.role2: approved design of this exact hand: keep its sleeve, bone-and-silver bracer, mortar crust and bone rings
OS.text:
THE HAND: the Ossuarist's left hand exactly as in image 2: a long fitted midnight-indigo sleeve ending in a carved bone-ivory and silver bracer with one plain oval silver boss, a thick crust of dried grey lime mortar on the back of the hand running down the knuckles, THREE big carved finger-bone rings on the index, middle and ring fingers. Line: "Only borrowing, love. We'll put them back."
SHOWCASE MOMENT: the hand turns its back toward the viewer, then the fingers lift and open in offer; from the three bone rings rise FOUR or FIVE small, still, cold cyan-white soul points that hang in the air above the fingers like quiet stars (small painted points with a soft edge, the ONLY cold light in the image, not bright); a few chunky flakes of grey mortar fall from the back of the hand; a faint cool rim light on the knuckles and rings. Gentle, knowing, a little uncanny.
COLOURS: indigo #1F2547, ink black #121320, bone ivory #EDE3CB, tarnished silver #A8AAB0, mortar #8C877D, soul points #CFF4FF; warm candle #E0A050.

BR.role2: approved design of this exact hand: keep its teal wave sleeve, shell bracelet and salt crust
BR.text:
THE HAND: the Brinecaller's left hand exactly as in image 2: a teal sleeve with a pale wave pattern and one big tide-line stain at the cuff, a bracelet of white shells and small coral beads, a big crust of pale grey-white salt crystals with a faint green cast on the back of the hand. Line: "Salt keeps. Salt cleans. Salt kills. Mind which you ask for."
SHOWCASE MOMENT: the hand turns, back of the hand to the viewer, and opens; pale salt grains run off the salt crust and fall from the fingers in a thin slow trickle like sand; a FEW (five to seven) small four-point glints sparkle on the salt crystals in the candlelight; a damp sheen on the knuckles as if the hand just came out of brine. No glow from the hand itself. Calm, dangerous, sea-cold.
COLOURS: teal #2F7F7A, wave white #D9E4DE, salt #D9DCD2 with green-grey #B4BCA9, shell #E8DEC8, coral #C0573E; warm candle #E0A050.

EX.role2: older draft of this hand: keep only its idea of a dark oiled leather glove; materials and colours follow image 3
EX.text:
THE HAND: the Exhumer's left hand in a dark brown oil-soaked leather glove exactly like the gloves and bracers of the Exhumer in image 3 (a flared leather gauntlet cuff with brass corner plates), the dark green coat sleeve above it; a pale worn patch on the thumb where the crossbow string rests. Line: "Keep your light low. The things worth killing see better than you."
SHOWCASE MOMENT: with a flick of the thumb a SMALL warm lamp flame (no bigger than the candle flame) catches on the oiled glove just above the cupped palm, lighting the glossy oil sheen of the leather from below; a thin wisp of grey smoke rises from it; the brass trims catch the light. Watchful, practical, light kept low.
COLOURS: oiled leather #5B4130 and #3A2A1E, coat green #2E4A3A, brass #B08A3E, lamp flame #F2A24A; warm candle #E0A050.

PS.role2: older draft of this hand: keep only its idea of a palm-up burn-scarred hand with ash-dark fingertips and a red thread; colours follow image 3
PS.text:
THE HAND: the Pyre-Singer's left hand and bare forearm exactly like the Pyre-Singer in image 3: the forearm wrapped criss-cross with red ribbon, a braid of red thread at the wrist, ONE smooth soft burn-scar patch across the palm (a single soft mass, no fine scar lines), fingertips ash-dark as one tone; where the forearm meets the wall, a short dark sleeve end of her black-red dress. Line: "Sing, so they don't go frightened."
SHOWCASE MOMENT: the hand opens palm-up; the palm warms like cooling coals with a soft orange glow, and a handful of warm embers (eight to twelve small orange sparks, a few with short trails) rise from it and drift upward; a little grey ash falls from the dark fingertips; the red ribbons and thread are brightly lit. Tender, mournful, warm.
COLOURS: skin with a smooth scar #A84B30, ash #26221F, red ribbon #B3262A, dress black-brown #2A1F1C, ember #E2622B; warm candle #E0A050.
